_comment: File-based substitute for the Core DB model/model_version/model_validation_record rows (TDS Sec 6.5). No live Postgres exists in this environment (see docs/phase2/phase2-completion-report.md and docs/phase3/phase3-model-validation-report.md Sec 1) -- this record captures every field those tables would, so nothing is lost, but it is not queryable the way a real registry row is. Reconciling this into the actual schema once Postgres is available is a Phase 4 prerequisite, not a Phase 3 one.

final_report_status_history.note: status explicitly unchanged by the audit
bounded/conditional promotion -- see report Sec 'Final Decision' for the scope this status covers

endpoint.name: hERG (KCNH2/Kv11.1) inhibition
endpoint.definition: label=1 (blocker) if aggregated IC50 <= 10000 nM (10 uM), else label=0 (non-blocker)
endpoint.threshold_note: 10 uM is a literature convention (commonly 1-30 uM across published hERG QSAR studies), not a universal biological constant
endpoint.target: ChEMBL CHEMBL240, Voltage-gated inwardly rectifying potassium channel KCNH2, Homo sapiens, target confidence 9 (direct single protein)

dataset.source: ChEMBL REST API (direct), CHEMBL240 IC50/nM activities, complete population not a sample (17,097 raw records)

deployment_variant._comment: Render's Starter plan (512MB RAM) could not hold the full 500-tree model in memory -- every hERG prediction request silently OOM-killed the process (visible in Render logs as the process dying between 'predict.request' and any response, followed by an instance restart, with CYP3A4's smaller 66MB model unaffected). Rather than pay for more RAM, the deployed artifact keeps only the first N of the original model's 500 already-trained trees (same trees, same training run -- not a retrain) to fit the memory budget. This is the artifact actually served by drugsim-predict-api; the metrics elsewhere in this file describe the full 500-tree research model, not this one.
deployment_variant.reason: out-of-memory on Render Starter plan (512MB) with the full 500-tree artifact

validation_group_8_metrics_at_35_trees.note: full 500-tree model scores roc_auc=0.8385 on the same validation split -- see hyperparameters/metrics above

validation_strategy.split_method: Global scaffold-level split_group (ADR-009): sha256(scaffold_key || split_salt) mod 10, deterministic, split_salt='herg_inhibition_v1'

leakage_checks.scaffold_leakage: PASS (direct re-check: 0 scaffolds span multiple split_groups)
leakage_checks.near_duplicate_leakage: REVIEW (15 pairs, 1.88% of test, Tanimoto>=0.95 across different scaffolds -- expected, documented)
leakage_checks.exact_feature_collision: REVIEW (3 of 800, 0.375%, residual folded-fingerprint collision after fixing an achiral-fingerprint bug that caused 30; manually inspected)

benchmark_split_random_proxy.note: random-split proxy, not a true TDC canonical split -- none exists for this ChEMBL-sourced dataset

metrics.gap_explanation: Global scaffold splitting prevents cross-dataset/near-neighbour leakage; the gap is the leakage the scaffold split removes.

components: max Tanimoto similarity to training set (Morgan fingerprints)
k-NN distance in standardised descriptor space (k=5, threshold=95th percentile of training-internal distances)
applicability_domain_method.verdict_logic: out_of_domain if max_tanimoto<0.4 OR >=2 of {max_tanimoto<0.6, knn_dist>p95_train, scaffold_not_in_training} triggered; borderline if exactly 1; else in_domain
applicability_domain_method.empirical_validation: 2-signal verdict (scaffold excluded, since it is tautologically triggered on any scaffold-holdout test set): in_domain accuracy 75.4% (n=500), borderline 66.9% (n=166), out_of_domain 58.2% (n=134) -- monotonic degradation confirms the AD carries real signal
applicability_domain_method.caveat: 3-signal in_domain verdict is 0/800 on THIS test set by construction (ADR-009 guarantees scaffold_not_in_training=True for every held-out compound); only reachable for a real query compound whose scaffold is already in the training pool

uncertainty_method.nonconformity_score: 1 - predicted probability of the candidate class
uncertainty_method.calibration_set: split_group 7 (n=976), used here for the first and only time in this pipeline

post_hoc_calibration_evaluated.recommendation: use raw predict_proba -- neither Platt nor isotonic post-hoc calibration improved on it

artifact.note: gitignored binary, not committed (Phase 1 Step 11: 'models/ holds code, never artefacts'); in a real deployment this would be object-storage-addressed by sha256 per TDS Sec 6.5
artifact.reproducibility: regenerate via: fetch_chembl_data.py -> build_dataset.py -> prepare_features.py -> train.py, in order, with RANDOM_SEED=42 fixed throughout; exact byte-identical retraining is NOT guaranteed since fetch_chembl_data.py re-queries a live external API that can gain new records over time (documented limitation, see Phase 3 report)

inference_support._comment: Added Phase 5. Frozen conformal calibration + AD reference data exported by models/admet/herg_inhibition/10_export_inference_support.py -- never recomputed at inference time.
